# ParikshaSathi

> AI-powered mock test and exam preparation platform for Indian government exams — SSC, WBCS, WBPSC, Railway, Banking and Police — in Bengali, Hindi and English.

ParikshaSathi helps aspirants prepare smarter with AI-generated mock tests, previous-year questions, deep analytics and an AI teacher that explains every wrong answer in the learner's chosen medium.
